resources.string: The quickest way to pay with the Blink wallet you already use.
It’s working — even if you can’t see the camera.
%1$s scans in the background so checkout stays smooth. Aim at the code, wait a beat, and you’re good.
Pay small amounts instantly — no extra taps.
Set a limit you’re comfortable with. For anything above it, %1$s will ask before paying.
Connect the Blink wallet you already use. %1$s focuses on fast in-person payments — everything else stays in your wallet.
Choose when %1$s should ask for confirmation before paying.

Using %1$s is at your own risk. This app connects to your own Lightning wallet — you are fully responsible for the funds in your wallet and any payments made.\n\nWe strongly recommend connecting wallets with small spending balances.
Follow these four steps in the Blink dashboard. %1$s needs Read and Write access to check your wallet and send payments.
Sign in with your Blink account. Email is recommended, but use whichever login method works for you.
After signing in, the dashboard opens API Keys. Tap + to create a new key.
Choose a name and expiry, and enable Read and Write access. Then tap Create.
Copy the value beginning with blink_ before closing. Return to %1$s and paste it on the next screen.
